title: Weather at one spot
goal: Record a temperature comparison with consistent method and separate measured change from explanation.
evidence: Student uses units, time and location, identifies a measured difference and proposes a further observation.
lesson: Outdoor weather mission followed by a short classroom comparison.
brief: Field record C. Heading 'How did the air temperature change?' Green/ochre journal interface. Method strip 'Same shaded spot • same thermometer • 1 m above ground'. Use the readings.' and blank 'What might explain it?' plus blank 'What should we record next?' Add photo/Sketch/Record voice and 'Save field record'. No claim that sun alone caused change, no forecast badge conflicting with data, no prefilled inference.
